title: Mississippi homeowner's $1,385-page insurance claim rejected after 2023 fire caused $440K in damage
summary_full: A Mississippi homeowner faced disappointment when her appeal for full insurance coverage following a 2023 fire was denied by a federal appeals court. Despite presenting 1,385 pages of evidence to contest her insurer's damage estimate of $440,092, the Fifth Circuit upheld the previous court's decision, highlighting the obstacles homeowners encounter in insurance disputes and concluding her quest for a fairer compensation.
